name: dithered-image
title: Dithered Image
description: OGL WebGL dithered image renderer with Bayer, halftone and void-and-cluster threshold maps.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/dithered-image-element.ts";
---

<motion-dithered-image
  image="/path/to/image.jpg"
  dither-map="bayer4x4"
  pixel-size="1"
  color="#6c87bc"
  background-color="#17181A"
  threshold="0.0"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/dithered-image-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-dithered-image
    image="/path/to/image.jpg"
    dither-map="bayer4x4"
    :pixel-size="1"
    color="#6c87bc"
    background-color="#17181A"
    :threshold="0.0"
    class="w-full h-[400px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/dithered-image-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-dithered-image
  image="/path/to/image.jpg"
  ditherMap="bayer4x4"
  pixelSize={1}

  backgroundColor="#17181A"
  threshold={0.0}
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/dithered-image-element.js"></script>

<motion-dithered-image
  image="/path/to/image.jpg"
  dither-map="bayer4x4"
  pixel-size="1"
  color="#6c87bc"
  background-color="#17181A"
  threshold="0.0"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

props.name: image
props.description: URL of the image to dither.

props.name: dither-map
props.description: Type of dithering threshold map to use.

props.name: pixel-size
props.description: Size of dithering pixels in screen pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Foreground color for the dithered pixels.

props.name: background-color
props.description: Background color for the dithered image.
